description: Implement the Step[TInput,TOutput] aggregate root exposing execute(input: TInput) -> StepExecutionResult[TOutput]. The Step owns internal Step Composition coordinating SPUs and supporting units. StepExecutionResult carries the processing artifact and independently optional contributions (validatorResult, errorResult, errorHandlerResult). Stage invokes Step only through the public callable boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: Step owns Step Composition coordinating SPUs and supporting units
StepExecutionResult optional result slots independently present/absent
Stage does not invoke SPUs or supporting units directly
StepLifecycle states RetainForReuse and TerminalRetirement implemented
Step Admission Boundary linearizable for execute invocations
definitionOfDone: Tests for optional result slot presence/absence semantics
Architecture test: Stage not permitted to call SPU directly
testStrategy: Unit tests for Step contract and optional contributions; architecture tests for boundary; lifecycle state-machine tests
